_note: portal-case-list-declarations, design D3 and D4. portalBranch is the vestigingsnummer of the company branch a case was filed under; portaliq's branch scope reads it through mijnZaken.branchField, so a session restricted to one branch sees only that branch's cases. portalIdentityKind says how a resident may reach a case of this type in the portal; absent means account only. No case type is seeded with reference, because portaliq does not yet check the e-mail address against the case.

portalBranch.title: Branch number
portalBranch.description: The branch number (vestigingsnummer) of the company that filed the case in the portal.

portalIdentityKind.title: Ways in to the portal
portalIdentityKind.description: How an applicant may open a case of this type in the portal. Empty means with an account only.
